rows.en: Wait!!
Hey! Wait!!
...Tch, they got away. But what the hell was that Core Medal!!
Ankh! Forget that for now. Saving Rider 1 and Rider 2 comes first!!
Ankh! Never mind that, let's hurry up and get Rider 1 and Rider 2 out of there!!
Ankh! Forget that for now. Saving Rider 1 and Rider 2 comes first!!
Ankh! Right now, lives matter more than Medals!! First, let's save our seniors, Rider 1 and Rider 2!!
Ankh! Forget that, Rider 1 and Rider 2 come first, right!? Let's hurry and save 'em, OK!?
Ankh! Saving Rider 1 and Rider 2 has to come first right now!!
Ankh, Rider 1 and Rider 2 are the priority. Commencing rescue operation!
Ankh! We've confirmed where Rider 1 and Rider 2 are. Rescuing them is our top priority now.
Ankh! Forget that for now. Saving Rider 1 and Rider 2 comes first!!
Ankh! Forget that for now. Saving Rider 1 and Rider 2 comes first!!
Hmph, don't give me orders!
In the next room were two operating tables, with Rider 1 and Rider 2 strapped down on them.
We'll save you right now!! Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
We're gonna get you outta there!! Hey, you handle that control panel, got it?
Hang on, we're getting you out!! Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
We'll get you out right now!! Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
Hang on, we're getting you out!! Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
We'll get you out right now!! Ankh, please, I need you on that control panel!!
We'll free you now... Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
We'll free you now... Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
We'll get you out now! Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
We'll save you! Ankh, I need you on that control panel.
Don't give me orders!!
...Tch, just this once, got it?
Ankh worked the machine, and the restraints holding Rider 1 and Rider 2 came loose.
Thank you, you saved us!
I owe you one!!
We came this close to being remodeled all over again.
That was a close one!
I'm glad we made it in time!
Good thing we made it in time.
Glad we made it in time.
I'm so glad we made it in time!
Good thing we made it in time.
I'm so glad we made it in time!
Glad we made it in time.
Glad we made it in time.
I'm glad we made it in time.
I'm glad we made it in time!
Kamen Rider 1 joined the party!
Hey, there's no reason to hang around a place like this. We're heading back to base!
Welcome, Kamen Rider 1! And the real Rider 2!
Whew, you really saved our lives.
...I never knew a place like this existed.
I'm Seravee Gundam. I handle the strategy side of things.
I'm Methuss. If you need treatment, leave it to me.
I'm Hikari. You could say I'm in charge of the technical side.
The heroes discussed a plan for their next objective: rescuing the Ultra Brothers.
...So the path to the place with the cross is blocked by boulders?
A small but powerful bomb would do the trick... Unfortunately, we have nothing suitable here.
A small bomb, huh...
Then let's just swipe one from the enemy!?
I doubt the enemy would be so convenient as to have one, though.
No, the enemy researches weapons and ammo too. They must be storing them somewhere.
My suspicion is the area even further in from where we were being held.
Ikadevil was coming and going from there a lot, too.
See!? You hear that, you lot!? If the great Rider 1 says so, it's gotta be true!
Understood. Then investigate that area.
A mysterious Shocker kaijin was born from the Neo-Organism's body!!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Rider 1! Rider 2!
Kamen Rider 1! Kamen Rider 2!
Gwoooooooh!! Who was iiiiiiit!!
Hey!! Stop thrashing around!!
Grrrgh... Wooooaaaaaagh!! Who was it that killed meeee!!
Someone!! Give me a hand!
Are you all right!?
Hold down that side!!
Yeah, got it.

notes.note: Slot 10 of the leader-variant 'Wait!!' block begun in story_054 (#0.46-0.55).
'Nigeyagatta' subject restored as 'they' (Ikadevil left with the child-voiced being, story_054 #0.44-45).

#0.58-0.67, #0.72-0.81, #0.90-0.99, #0.129-0.138 are 10-slot leader-variant blocks. Pt_Chara_Check order in the 0331 script: 1 Black RX, 2 Den-O Sword Form, 3 W (Shotaro), 4 OOO, 5 Zero, 6 Mebius, 7 00, 8 Wing Zero, 9 Zeta Gundam, 10 Nu Gundam. Wording matches (slot 4 'sempai'/lives over Medals, slot 6 'Ankh-san'). Identical Japanese given identical English.
OOO's 'senpai' for the Riders rendered 'our seniors' per glossary; dropped in the short shout at #0.132 (and Mebius' '-san' at #0.134).
'Tanomu' is the leader asking Ankh: rendered 'I need you on that control panel' to keep the direction. #0.73 (Momotaros) says 'oi' instead of Ankh's name.
Unlabelled; follows the 10 variants (#0.72-0.81), so read as Ankh's retort before his labelled #0.83.
'Saikaizou' = being cyborg-modified again; 'remodeled all over again'.
Rows #0.105-0.127 have no recovered speaker. #0.105 is a base member's greeting, kept neutral; #0.106 read as Rider 2 (easygoing), #0.107 as Rider 1.
Unlabelled. 'The cross' kept singular to match story_046 ('area with the cross').

Unlabelled; likely Hikari (tech). #0.118 and #0.123 read as the same rough-spoken hero, who calls Rider 1 'dai-senpai' -> 'the great Rider 1'. #0.119 sceptic and #0.124 planner (Seravee-type) unidentified.
Source has 'tachi ga' with no word before it (likely a dropped pronoun); read as Rider 1 talking about where he and Rider 2 were held, so 'we'.
'Neo seimeitai' rendered 'Neo-Organism' (Kamen Rider ZO's English name); not in glossary. Align with story_054 if it chose otherwise.
??? is the Armored Samurai Kaijin (named in story_056 #0.158). 'Dare da' tied to #0.148 'the one who killed me' -> 'Who was it'. New roar 'Gwoooooooh!!'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant blocks voiced from the script's Pt_Chara_Check order (RX, Den-O, W, OOO, Zero, Mebius, 00, Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu). #0.121 source lacks the word before 'tachi'; read as 'we'. Speakers of #0.105-0.127 not recovered; inferred. Not in glossary: Neo-Organism; new Armored Samurai Kaijin roar.
